selection_rationale: Nine of twelve mechanisms are killed, a 100% kill ratio among non-survivors. M786-01 retains the exact all-circuit transversal objective after the proved high-tail bounded-length theorem. M786-09 is the only arithmetic route that permits reused prime fibres and attempts bounded-congestion peeling. M786-11 retains the exact fixed-N forbidden-support ILP but demands a genuinely uniform fractional-cover and rank-sensitive rounding theorem. Totally additive separation, exact-one prime layers, common dilation, squarefree/short-circuit shortcuts, private labels, dimension-only bounds, nonlinear density supply, and marker-free gluing are excluded.
